newsitem.title: USA: AES to buy AES China Generating.
newsitem.headline: AES to buy AES China Generating.

text.p: AES Corp said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire about 8.2 million oustanding Class A shares of AES China Generating Co Inc in a stock swap valued at between $107 million and $120 million.
Under the deal, the acquisition would be accomplished by amalgamating AES China Generating, also known as AES Chigen, with a wholly owned AES subsidiary.

AES Chigen shareholders would receive shares of AES common stock at an exchange rate of 0.29 shares of AES common stock for each share of AES Chigen common stock within an AES share price range of $45 to $50, it said.
If AES common stock trades above $50 per share, the exchange ratio will be adjusted so that each AES Chigen shareholder would receive AES shares valued at $14.50 per Chigen share, it said.
If it trades below $45 per share, the exchange ratio would be adjusted so that each AES Chigen sareholders would receive AES shares valued at $13.05 per Chigen share.
The exchange ratio will be determined by the average cloging price of AES common stock over 15 trading days leading up to the merger.
If the exchange ratio is adjusted to be greater than 0.31, AES can back out of the deal. If the exchange ratio is adjusted to be less than 0.28, AES Chigen does not have to consummate the deal.
AES Chigen, an affiliate of AES, develops, owns and operates power generation facilities in China. AES is a power company that generates, sells or markets electricity in more than 35 countries.
